claims: Modified on Thu, 1 Oct: the outright prohibition list now has 83 names (adds Palestine and Turkey) and still does not include India.
The restriction test still covers citizenship, residence, and prolonged predominant trading location.
Germany and Canada outside Ontario remain Funded Sim only; new Ukrainian users cannot onboard with Riseworks.
Unchanged (modified 21 Jul 2025): broker, clearing firm and Riseworks KYC/AML with government-issued ID plus bank statement or utility bill.
Credit/debit card via NMI or Braintree, plus Google Pay, Apple Pay and PayPal (modified 27 May).
Riseworks has 2 options for payouts: Bank wire and Crypto.
US bank wire withdrawals: Free International bank wire withdrawals: $15/withdrawal L1 Crypto Withdrawals: $2.5/withdrawal + Estimated Gas Fees. L2 Crypto Withdrawals: Free.

Rendered homepage (headless Chrome, 2026-10-20): hero 'Now up to 55% OFF! Accounts from just $45!', pricing header 'Simple pricing. No hidden fees. Up to 60% off!'; default Daily Payouts / Intraday cards 25k-150k at $45 / $59 / $108 / $162 per month (list $100 / $131 / $240 / $360).

unresolvedConflicts: No Indian checkout, KYC approval, payout-provider invitation, bank-wire receipt, crypto receipt, or INR settlement was independently tested.
The displayed fees are tied to a 55%-off campaign rather than verified stable list prices.
First-party pages conflict on whether a funded-stage KYC failure produces a refund.
